analysis.summaryJa: このページは、人の目的語を表すwho・whomと、人以外を表すwhichを役割で選び分ける。日常的な目的格who、改まった目的格whom、前置詞の直後に置くwhom、主語には使えないwhomを対比し、物・動物・組織の主語穴と目的語穴にはwhichを使う。
grammarPoints: 人が関係節の主語ならwhoを使う
人が関係節の目的語なら日常文ではwho、改まった文ではwhomを使える
前置詞を関係語の前へ出す改まった形ではwhomを使う
whomは関係節の主語には使えない
物・事柄・通常の動物を受ける主格・目的格にはwhichを使う
whichが主語なら直後に動詞、目的語なら別の主語が続く
目的格who・whom・whichの後ろに代名詞目的語を重ねない
制限用法では人・物ともthatを使えるが前置詞直後にはthatを置けない
visualEvidence: 人物レーンがWHOとWHOMへ、物・動物レーンがWHICHへ分岐する案内図になっている
カジュアルなwho目的格とフォーマルなwhom目的格が服装の違うキャラクターで比較されている
to whom・with whomの前置詞前置ボックスと、whomを主語位置へ置く禁止表示がある
WHICHゲートには機械・書類・動物・会社のカードが入り、主語穴と目的語穴へ分かれている
commonTraps: 前置詞の直後にwhoを置く改まった構文を作る
目的格whomの後ろにhimやherを重ねる
人以外の先行詞にwhoやwhomを使う
whichが主語なのにitを追加する
動物なら常にwhoと決め付ける

questions.prompt: The officer ------- checks visitor badges is stationed at the east entrance.

choices.B: whom

questions.translationJa: 来訪者バッジを確認する警備員は東口に配置されています。

questions.prompt: The consultant ------- the board selected has accepted the assignment.

questions.prompt: The customer ------- I called asked for a written confirmation.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct everyday sentence with object who.

choices.B: The client who we contacted him responded immediately.
choices.C: The client whom contacted us responded immediately.
choices.D: The client which we contacted responded immediately.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a fronted preposition.

questions.translationJa: 報告すべきマネージャーはグリーンさんです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using with whom.

choices.C: The representatives with whom we met support the proposal.

questions.explanationJa: 前置詞withの後ろに人を受けるwhomを置き、themは追加しません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with which as the subject.

choices.C: The software whom tracks deliveries is being upgraded.
choices.D: The software which tracks deliveries is being upgraded.

questions.translationJa: 配送を追跡するソフトウェアは更新中です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an animal neutrally.

choices.B: The bird whom nests near the loading dock is protected.
choices.C: The bird which it nests near the loading dock is protected.
choices.D: The bird where nests near the loading dock is protected.

questions.translationJa: 荷役場付近に巣を作る鳥は保護対象です。
questions.explanationJa: 動物birdを一般的・中立的に説明し、nestsの主語とするwhichが適切です。

choices.A: The brochure which you requested it is available online.
choices.B: The brochure which you requested is available online.
choices.C: The brochure who you requested is available online.
choices.D: The brochure which requested you is available online.

questions.translationJa: ご依頼のパンフレットはオンラインで利用できます。

choices.D: The carrier where provides overnight delivery charges a premium.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after a fronted preposition.

choices.B: The director for that the reservation was made has arrived.
choices.C: The director whom the reservation was made for him has arrived.
choices.D: The director for whom the reservation was made has arrived.

questions.translationJa: 予約対象となっていた取締役が到着しました。

questions.explanationJa: whoはemployeeをtrainsの主語としてつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The guest whom the hotel assisted wrote a review.”

questions.translationJa: ホテルが支援した宿泊客はレビューを書きました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The technician who I called is on the way.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The person to whom the key was given is absent.”
